d: Football is a game of physical battles, but sometimes a collision can have consequences no one could have imagined. The death of Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel has left Spanish football in mourning. Barcelona players and Real Madrid have offered their condolences. However, it has raised difficult questions about player safety, on-field emergencies and the abuse directed at the goalkeeper involved. Rupha Ramani examines the incident and the heartbreaking aftermath.
